query: 召回程序及披露 召回程序及披露 衡量企业对潜在缺陷或安全风险产品执行召回的制度完备性与信息公开透明度。重点考察召回触发阈值、风险分级管理、消费者通知渠道及回收实物的闭环追踪能力。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备量化的召回触发指标；实行风险分级制度（如：严重、一般、轻微）；建立了多渠道主动通知机制（官网、短信、媒体）；并披露了详细的召回物资处置与效果评估流程。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的召回管理制度，具备基础的召回审批和执行流程，符合监管要求的被动披露程序，但缺乏主动监控触发机制或详细的风险分级说明。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式召回制度披露，或仅笼统提及“依法执行召回”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：召回管理制度覆盖 >80% 的产品品类及所有销售区域（含海外市场），且定期进行模拟召回演练。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对强监管产品（如汽车、药品）执行，或未披露制度的适用范围比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 产品召回程序 召回制度 召回触发 风险分级 消费者通知 追溯 模拟召回 召回演练 召回效果评估 product recall procedure recall policy recall trigger risk classification consumer notification traceability mock recall simulated recall recall effectiveness 是否有正式召回管理制度及量化触发阈值？ 是否实行严重/一般/轻微等风险分级？ 消费者通知渠道有哪些？ 召回物资如何追踪与处置并评估效果？ 制度覆盖哪些品类与销售区域，是否有模拟召回演练？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '召回程序及披露'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式召回管理制度及量化触发阈值？ 是否实行严重/一般/轻微等风险分级？ 消费者通知渠道有哪些？ 召回物资如何追踪与处置并评估效果？ 制度覆盖哪些品类与销售区域，是否有模拟召回演练？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法召回”表述；仅有召回率数字；仅有产品安全政策总述而无召回细则；仅有监管处罚新闻无企业程序；区分：召回程序及披露关注制度触发分级通知与闭环追踪；产品安全政策是更广的全生命周期机制；产品回收率是结果统计指标。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group has established a data collection system and commissioned a professional consultant to quantify its greenhouse gas emissions annually in accordance with the guidelines compiled by the Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department of Hong Kong 1 , and with reference to the guidelines issued by the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China 2 and relevant international standards 3 . This helps the Group to continuously review the effectiveness of the existing measures and develop more targeted energy saving and carbon reduction plans.

[Section]
Material Issues / Environmental Management

[Content]
The Group has established a data collection system and commissioned a professional consultant to quantify its greenhouse gas emissions annually in accordance with the guidelines compiled by the Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department of Hong Kong 1 , and with reference to the guidelines issued by the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China 2 and relevant international standards 3 . This helps the Group to continuously review the effectiveness of the existing measures and develop more targeted energy saving and carbon reduction plans.

results.text: As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

[Section]
Material Issues / Green Buildings

[Content]
As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

results.text: The Group strictly complies with all applicable regulations. During the Reporting Year, the Group did not have any violations or lawsuits related to environmental protection, employment management, product liability and corruption. No new laws and regulations that might have a significant impact on the business had been identified. For more details, please refer to the section 'Compliance Performance' in the 'Key Performance Indicator Summary' of this Report. In addition, the Group carried out sustainability risk assessment during the Reporting Year, covering both physical and transitional risks. The Group will continue to review and enhance the effectiveness of relevant management procedures based on the reports and recommendations.

Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. [Content]
The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development sets development goals for the nation's construction industry. By 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be fully constructed as green building. More than 50 million square meters of ultra-low energy and near-zero energy buildings will be built. Prefabricated buildings shall account for 30% of new urban buildings of the year. The installed capacity of solar photovoltaics in new buildings will be more than 50 million kilowatts. The application area of geothermal buildings will be more than 100 million square meters, and the replacement rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%. The proportion of electricity consumption in building energy consumption is more than 55%. With these goals, a green, low-carbon, and circular construction and development mode will be formed, and a solid foundation will be laid for carbon peaking in urban and rural construction by 2030.
